SELF_AUDIT.SCALABILITY_CURVE: DTO layout is invariant and never consumes GlobalQualityWeight. Continuous scalability is traversal-only: systems reading aligned rows may increase stride/cadence through math.lerp, math.smoothstep, and deterministic bucket dithering below 0.3. That bypasses optional evaluation work, not memory truth. At high quality, the same rows feed denser visual/shader/telemetry consumers without changing offsets, size, authority route, or save identity.
